== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Silent King]]’s crown, also referred to as the crown of the [[Silent King]] or the [[Silent King]]'s Crown, is a white object that serves as a burning halo above the head of the [[Silent King]]. A piece of this halo was used to create a crown that [[Lindon]] discovered within a [[labyrinth]], which functioned as the legacy of an ancient [[Monarch]]. This specific crown acts as an additional source of power and an amplifier for [[Dross]], allowing him to utilize his abilities more offensively. It has been used to magnify mental assaults against targets and to provide a temporary [[veil]] for concealment. Additionally, the crown is associated with a [[Goldsign]] that resembles a miniature version of the original halo.}}
